tips.text: Start the infection first; it is the long clock, so farm the egg and build the Power Core while the cyst matures.
Without Nidus, run public missions on a spare frame; infection spreads fast in public squads.
Do not pick Remove cyst in the chair by accident; that frame is immune for good, so infect a different one.
Ignore the pink growth from a Coda infection; only a matured Helminth Cyst unlocks Drain.
If Nidus shows no cyst after more than a week, get a different frame infected by another player and use that one.
Press Drain when you start incubating; once an egg is incubating the option is gone and it hatches a normal Kubrow.
If it will not equip after maturing, relog or start any mission.
Chargers roll random sizes; rerolling takes another cyst drain, egg and core.
Expect about nine days of calendar time and under an hour of play.
Players like it as a fun Nidus-lite pet, not the strongest companion.
